$description: Light theme (DMNC-1058, palette slice). A clean light surface for products that want a light/modern look. Palette-only for now — contemporary typography/corners/font are the broader Modern-theme follow-up. Amber stays the brand, but brand/accent/functional TEXT darkens for AA contrast on white (phosphor amber #FFB000 is only ~1.9:1 on white). Honest CGA functional hues, darkened where needed for AA.

accent.$description: Amber accent fill — pair with dark on-brand text.

brand.$description: Amber brand fill (e.g. primary button) — pair with text.onBrand.

brandBright.$description: Brand emphasis fill (hover/active) — a deeper amber so it reads against amber on light.

brandDim.$description: Dim amber surface (low-emphasis fills/headers) on light.

error.$description: Honest red fill — pair with white foreground.

success.$description: Green fill — pair with white foreground.

primary.$description: Warm near-black body text (~13:1 on bg.primary).

tertiary.$description: Third-emphasis text; same as muted on light.

brand.$description: Brand-amber TEXT on light — darkened to amberDim range; phosphor #FFB000 fails AA on white (~1.9:1), this is ~5:1.

brandBright.$description: Brand emphasis text (hover/active peaks) on light — darker still.

onBrand.$description: Text/icon on an amber brand fill (dark on amber).

error.$description: Honest red error text (~5.9:1 on white).

warning.$description: Amber/brown warning text, readable on light.

success.$description: Green success text, darkened for AA on white.

info.$description: Cyan/blue info text, darkened for AA on white.

white.$description: Light foreground for dark/functional fills (white-on-red, etc.).

focus.$description: Focus ring — deep amber, visible on light.

default.$description: Link — darkened cyan/blue, AA on white.

visited.$description: Visited — violet (matches the AI-marker light gradient).

error.$description: Subtle red error glow on light.
